raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Without the copy-engine transport (ROCm), each H3 layer packs q/k/v, waits on the input all-to-all, attends, then waits on the output all-to-all: ~2.5 ms of exposed RCCL per layer at 1280x704 on 4xMI355X (14.5% of a denoise step).

## Modifications

- Split the local heads into two groups: queue both input exchanges up front on the collective stream, and send group g's output while group g+1 attends. aiter attends a head group with the same bytes as inside the full call (verified), so the output is bit-identical.
- Two groups was the best choice: 7 groups, 14 groups and unequal splits ([4,10], [2,10,2]) are all slower because attention gets a partial extra wave per call.
- Test added to `test_usp_pipelined_attention_multi_gpu.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

Bit-identical output: 22/22 MP4 md5s equal to main in the final run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Setup for all numbers below: 4x MI355X, MiniMax-H3 T2VA, 1280x704 (SemiAnalysis "720p"), 124 frames, 49 forwards, Ulysses 4 + aiter, single stream. Each arm is a fresh server (1 warmup + 3 timed requests), ABAB across two rounds, base = main `75a5da7f`.

720p median -3.24 s (the largest single item). Per step, ~63 ms of RCCL is now hidden behind attention; 849.5 -> 738 ms/step together with the QK norm change.

Note: this touches the same H3 pipelined-Ulysses block in `minimax_h3.py` as the CUDA-side PR that skips the packing's alignment rows; whichever lands second needs a small rebase.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit config (isort / ruff / black pass).
- [x] Add unit tests (merged into the existing test file for the touched area).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).

@@ -459,6 +459,72 @@ def _usp_input_all_to_all_packed_qkv(
     return q, k, v
 
 
+def ulysses_head_group_pipelined_attention(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    attend,
+    groups: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Ulysses attention with the collective exchange pipelined over head groups.
+
+    q/k/v are matching ``[rows, heads, head_size]`` row shards and
+    ``attend(q, k, v)`` attends one head group over the gathered rows; it must
+    treat heads independently, so the result is the sequential exchange's
+    bytes. Every input exchange is queued up front on the collective stream
+    and group g's output exchange runs while group g + 1 attends.
+    """
+    group = get_sp_group().ulysses_group
+    world_size = get_ulysses_parallel_world_size()
+    rows, heads, head_size = q.shape
+    group_heads = heads // (world_size * groups)
+    # pack block w * groups + g holds rank w's heads of group g
+    packed = pack_qkv_destination_major(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        world_size * groups,
+        out=_a2a_staging_buffer(
+            "usp_packed_qkv_src",
+            (world_size * groups, rows, group_heads, 3 * head_size),
+            q.dtype,
+            q.device,
+        ),
+    ).view(world_size, groups, rows, group_heads, 3 * head_size)
+    received = _a2a_staging_buffer(
+        "usp_packed_qkv_recv",
+        (groups, world_size, rows, group_heads, 3 * head_size),
+        q.dtype,
+        q.device,
+    )
+    exchanges = [
+        dist.all_to_all(
+            list(received[g].unbind(0)),
+            list(packed[:, g].unbind(0)),
+            group=group,
+            async_op=True,
+        )
+        for g in range(groups)
+    ]
+    out = _a2a_staging_buffer(
+        "usp_output",
+        (groups, world_size, rows, group_heads, head_size),
+        q.dtype,
+        q.device,
+    )
+    for g in range(groups):
+        exchanges[g].wait()
+        group_qkv = received[g].view(world_size * rows, group_heads, 3 * head_size)
+        group_out = attend(*group_qkv.split(head_size, dim=-1))
+        exchanges.append(
+            dist.all_to_all_single(out[g], group_out, group=group, async_op=True)
+        )
+    for exchange in exchanges[groups:]:
+        exchange.wait()
+    # [group, rank, row, head, dim] -> [row, rank, group, head, dim]
+    return out.permute(2, 1, 0, 3, 4).reshape(rows, heads, head_size)
+
+

     """True when ``x.view(b * s_local, h, d)`` costs no copy.

+# aiter's varlen kernel gives a head group the same bytes as those heads inside
+# the full call (checked at H3's shapes on MI355X)
+_COLLECTIVE_PIPELINED_ATTENTION_BACKENDS = (AttentionBackendEnum.AITER,)
+
+
+def _minimax_h3_collective_pipelined_attention(
+    attention: MiniMaxH3Attention,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_host: tuple[int, ...] | None,
+    max_seqlen: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """Dense attention with the collective Ulysses exchange pipelined over head
+    groups, for backends the copy-engine pipeline does not serve.
+
+    Returns None (caller keeps the sequential exchange) unless pipelining is
+    enabled. Auto picks two groups: every further group adds a partial
+    attention wave (MI355X, 14 heads per rank: two groups save 1.5 ms per
+    layer, seven cost 2.8 ms).
+    """
+    groups = envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_ULYSSES_PIPELINE_GROUPS
+    if groups < 0:
+        groups = 2
+    world_size, _ = get_ulysses_ctx()
+    if (
+        groups in (0, 1)
+        or attention._attention_backend_enum
+        not in _COLLECTIVE_PIPELINED_ATTENTION_BACKENDS
+        or q.shape[1] % (world_size * groups)
+        or torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+        or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+    ):
+        return None
+    impl = attention._attention_impl
+
+    def attend(q_group, k_group, v_group):
+        return impl.forward_varlen(
+            q_group,
+            k_group,
+            v_group,
+            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+            max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+            cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens_host,
+        )
+
+    return ulysses_head_group_pipelined_attention(q, k, v, attend, groups)
+
+

     attention: MiniMaxH3Attention,

 The pipeline only engages on a same-host Ulysses group with peer-to-peer access,
 so nothing in the single-GPU suite reaches it. Runs on 2 ranks, and on 4 when
-four GPUs are visible:
+four GPUs are visible; the collective (NCCL/RCCL) head-group pipeline runs on 4
+ranks on any platform:
 
     pytest -v python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/single_test_file/test_usp_pipelined_attention_multi_gpu.py
 """
@@ -223,9 +224,61 @@ def fill_all(blocks, part):
     return 1 if verdict.item() else 0
 
 
+def _collective_worker() -> int:
+    """The collective head-group pipeline against the sequential packed exchange."""
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    )
+
+    rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
+    world = int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(rank)
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(
+        tp_size=1, sp_size=world, ulysses_degree=world
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers import usp
+
+    def attend(q, k, v):
+        # head-independent but row-order dependent, like attention
+        return torch.cumsum(q.float() * k.flip(0).float(), dim=0).to(q.dtype) + v
+
+    rows, dim = 37, 128
+    failures = []
+    for heads_per_rank in (8, 14):
+        heads = heads_per_rank * world
+        torch.manual_seed(rank)
+        qkv = torch.randn(rows, 3 * heads * dim, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        # q/k/v are views of a fused projection, as in MiniMax-H3
+        q, k, v = (t.view(rows, heads, dim) for t in qkv.split(heads * dim, dim=-1))
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            gathered = usp._usp_input_all_to_all_packed_qkv(q, k, v)
+            ref = usp._usp_output_all_to_all(attend(*gathered)[None], head_dim=2)[0]
+            for groups in (2, heads_per_rank // 2):
+                out = usp.ulysses_head_group_pipelined_attention(
+                    q, k, v, attend, groups
+                )
+                if not torch.equal(out, ref):
+                    failures.append(f"{heads_per_rank} heads/rank, {groups} groups")
+
+    verdict = torch.tensor([len(failures)], device="cuda")
+    dist.all_reduce(verdict)
+    if failures:
+        print(f"rank{rank} MISMATCH: {failures}", flush=True)
+    if rank == 0:
+        print(
+            f"USP_PIPELINE_PARITY {'FAIL' if verdict.item() else 'PASS'} world={world}",
+            flush=True,
+        )
+    dist.barrier()
+    dist.destroy_process_group()
+    return 1 if verdict.item() else 0
+
+
 class TestUspPipelinedAttentionMultiGpu(CustomTestCase):
-    def _run(self, world: int, port: int):
-        if not current_platform.is_cuda():
+    def _run(self, world: int, port: int, worker: str = "--worker"):
+        if worker == "--worker" and not current_platform.is_cuda():
             self.skipTest("the copy-engine pipeline is CUDA-only")
         if torch.cuda.device_count() < world:
             self.skipTest(f"needs {world} GPUs")
@@ -237,7 +290,7 @@ def _run(self, world: int, port: int):
                 f"--nproc-per-node={world}",
                 f"--master-port={port}",
                 __file__,
-                "--worker",
+                worker,
             ],
             capture_output=True,
             text=True,
@@ -256,8 +309,13 @@ def test_two_ranks_match_sequential_bitwise(self):
     def test_four_ranks_match_sequential_bitwise(self):
         self._run(4, 29557)
 
+    def test_collective_pipeline_matches_sequential_bitwise(self):
+        self._run(4, 29567, worker="--collective-worker")
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     if "--worker" in sys.argv:
         raise SystemExit(_worker())
+    if "--collective-worker" in sys.argv:
+        raise SystemExit(_collective_worker())
     unittest.main()
